fact: Researchers of the Algerian Space Agency's Centre des Techniques Spatiales used 25 Sentinel-2A images and field plots managed by the technical institute of field crops to derive NDVI cereal profiles and cereal area maps for Sidi Bel Abbes in the 2020-2021 season.
title: Cereal crop identification using Sentinel2 time series, case of Sidi Bel Abbes area
publisher: The International Archives of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences (ISPRS)
